en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5611 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who passed away and left behind his parents.
Imam (as) said: "The mother receives one-third, and the father receives two-thirds."
